+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: AgentRun accepts a message, or tells that it ended
+---
+## What
+A caller must be able to send a message to a run that it started. The run must accept the message or tell that it ended. There must be no race with the idle rule.
+
+Files:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun.swift`
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun+Drive.swift`
+- New: `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRunMessageOutcome.swift`
+
+Approach:
+- Add `enum AgentRunMessageOutcome: Sendable, Equatable { case delivered; case ended(AgentRunState) }`.
+- Add `func deliver(_ message: String) async -> AgentRunMessageOutcome` to `AgentRun`.
+  - Under the `storage` lock: if the state is not `.running`, or the run has started its teardown, or the run has no session (`heldSession == nil`, a setup failure), return `.ended` with the known final state.
+  - Otherwise, increment a new `Storage.inboundMessages` count, and get the session.
+  - Outside the lock: call `session.send(message)`, then decrement the count.
+- Add a "closing" flag to `Storage`. `drive` sets it under the lock before its teardown (`children.cancelOpenRuns()`, `session.cancel()`, `session.close()`) in `AgentRun+Drive.swift:51-55`. When the flag is set, `deliver` gives `.ended`.
+- `isIdle(on:)` (`AgentRun+Drive.swift:261`) must give `false` while `inboundMessages > 0`. The existing check `messageQueueDepth().waiting == 0` then covers the message after `send` returns.
+- The order is: the drive sets "closing" under the lock only when `inboundMessages == 0`. Otherwise it does not end, and it waits for the next event.
+- The session sees the message as a caller message (`RoutedSession.send(_:)`). Put a short prefix that names the sender, for example `Message from your caller:`, in one constant in `AgentsToolText`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `deliver` on a running run gives `.delivered`, and the session answers the message before the run ends.
+- [ ] `deliver` on a finished, failed, or cancelled run gives `.ended` with that state.
+- [ ] `deliver` on a run whose setup failed gives `.ended`.
+- [ ] A run that gets a message just as its last answer ends does not end before it answers that message.
+- [ ] The final message of the run is the reply of its last answer, as before (the idle rule is not changed otherwise).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentRunMessageTests.swift`, using `AgentRunHarness` and the scripted model:
+  - delivered to a run in its task turn;
+  - delivered to a run that waits for children;
+  - ended after finish, after cancel, and after a setup failure;
+  - the race: a message that `deliver` starts before the idle check is answered.
+- [ ] The existing `NestedRunTests+Idle.swift` tests pass unchanged.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then do the implementation until they pass.
\ No newline at end of file

The call sends the held messages in order, then sets .open. A message that arrives while the release sends is held too, thus the order stays.
